answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like an opal held in escrow: the stake sits visible in the open nebula of the ledger, and any peer can flag a suspicious identity for a grading jury. If the jury confirms the identity is fake, the stake is slashed and paid to the reporter, while an honest agent gets its stake back in full. A lotus of fake accounts would each have to fund a stake they are likely to lose, so spawning thousands of sybils becomes an expensive gamble instead of a free one.
